meta.title: Primo Cafe
meta.description: Primo Cafe is Lancaster's premier all-day diner, located in the Valley Central Shopping Center off Highway 14. Famous for our hearty Chorizo Burritos, authentic Menudo, and daily breakfast classics.

hero.headline:
Lancaster's Favorite
Diner off Highway 14
hero.subtext: Savor hearty, expertly crafted diner classics—from massive Chorizo Burritos to our famous Chicken Fried Steak. Skip the app fees and get your food faster.

about.heading: Fresh, Flavorful Dining in Valley Central
about.story: Located right in the Valley Central Shopping Center, Primo Cafe is your go-to spot for Antelope Valley's best comfort food. Whether you're commuting and need a quick breakfast, or sitting down for our signature Carne Asada Pizza, we prepare every meal with the finest ingredients. Support local and order directly through our official site.

social.ratingText: Google rating score: 4.0 of 5, based on 1013 reviews

reviews.name: Paul Wilson
reviews.text: Primo's is one of the best restaurants in Lancaster I'm currently living in Georgia right now but I'm moving back to Lancaster here soon primo's is my first restaurant that I'm going to be going to I love their food and I love their customer service they are great people.

reviews.name: Luis Martinez
reviews.text: Food was pretty good, service was fast and staff was friendly. Will definitely be back.

reviews.name: Natasha Russell
reviews.text: This Cafe is a must try for anyone who's looking for some pretty darn good tasty food as well as the warm cozy ambiance. Also the Servers are friendly and pleasant. The food is fresh and hot nice hefty amount and good prices. I've been Twice and both visits was a nice experience. Will definitely be my go to place to pop in.

reviews.name: Kevin Downing
reviews.text: We enjoyed a nice family outing here. Very friendly waitress and nice homey atmosphere. The men's bathroom needs a little remodeling.
